submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires on a token that is a highly predictable continuation of its immediate 1-3 token prefix, i.e. when the prefix plus the current token form a familiar collocation or construction slot (verb/determiner sequences like 'opened the' and 'before the', 'contain at', 'are all capital', 'bank raised', sentence-initial determiner+noun like 'The defendant' or 'Our quarterly'). The same surface token (e.g. ' the', ' at', ' capital', ' heavy') fires after a familiar prefix but not after an unexpected one, and changing the following token leaves firing unchanged; its output direction promotes plural/collective nouns (projects, programs, systems, companies, datasets).
